members.command: bash -c 'set -eu; W="$TMPDIR/coax"; R="$TMPDIR/profile-result"; mkdir -p "$W" "$R"; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$R/allocation-start.txt"; sha256sum /pub/wagnera3/coax-drone/payload/coax-drone-frequency-20261115-r2.tar > "$R/payload-sha256.txt"; tar -xf /pub/wagnera3/coax-drone/payload/coax-drone-frequency-20261115-r2.tar -C "$W"; cd "$W"; export PYTHONPATH="$W"; python -c '"'"'import sys, calc.budget as b; print(b.__file__); sys.exit(0 if b.__file__.startswith(sys.argv[1]) else 3)'"'"' "$W" > "$R/import-path.txt"; printf "%s\n" "job=$SLURM_JOB_ID" "node=$SLURMD_NODENAME" "cpus=$SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK" > "$R/allocation.txt"; cat /proc/cpuinfo > "$R/cpuinfo.txt"; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$R/compute-start.txt"; TIMEFORMAT="wall_seconds=%R user_seconds=%U system_seconds=%S cpu_percent=%P"; { time python -m cProfile -o "$R/calls.prof" "$(command -v coax-uncertainty)" shard --repo-root "$W" --study calc/budget/data/uncertainty-study.json --shard 0 --shards 1024 --out "$R/cases.json"; } > "$R/stdout.txt" 2> "$R/timing.txt"; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$R/compute-end.txt"; sha256sum "$R/cases.json" > "$R/cases-sha256.txt"; mkdir -p /pub/wagnera3/coax-drone/performance/profile-20261115; tar -cf /pub/wagnera3/coax-drone/performance/profile-20261115/profile-shard0of1024.tar -C "$R" .; test -s /pub/wagnera3/coax-drone/performance/profile-20261115/profile-shard0of1024.tar'
